exposure: Elevated blood pressure (120-129/<80 mm Hg) in early third trimester
Stage 1 hypertension (130-139/80-89 mm Hg) in early third trimester
Stage 2 hypertension (≥140/90 mm Hg) in early third trimester
cohort: The study included 4,692 pregnant individuals whose blood pressure was measured in the early third trimester (median gestational age 27.9 weeks).
finding: Pregnant individuals with elevated blood pressure (BP > 120/80 mm Hg) in the early third trimester experienced a progressively higher frequency of adverse cardiometabolic outcomes, including type 2 diabetes and dyslipidemia, 10-14 years after delivery.
